import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset Set
open scoped BigOperators

theorem Rudin_exercise_5_5_unit_oscillation
  {f : ℝ → ℝ}
  (hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioi 0))
  (hf : Tendsto (deriv f) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℝ, ∀ x y : ℝ, N ≤ x → N ≤ y → |x - y| ≤ 1 → |f x - f y| < ε := by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hf) ε hε
  refine ⟨max N₀ 1, fun x y hx hy hxy => ?_⟩
  have h_case : ∀ a b, max N₀ 1 ≤ a → max N₀ 1 ≤ b → a < b → |a - b| ≤ 1 → |f a - f b| < ε := by
    intro a b ha hb hab hab_le
    have ha_pos : 0 < a := (zero_lt_one.trans_le (le_max_right N₀ 1)).trans_le ha
    have h_cont : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b) :=
      (hfd.mono fun t ht => ha_pos.trans_le ht.1).continuousOn
    have h_diff : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioo a b) :=
      hfd.mono fun t ht => ha_pos.trans ht.1
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hc_eq⟩ := exists_deriv_eq_slope f hab h_cont h_diff
    have hc_ge : N₀ ≤ c := (le_max_left N₀ 1).trans (ha.trans (le_of_lt hc.1))
    have hc_eps : |deriv f c| < ε := by
      have := hN₀ c hc_ge
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at this
      exact this
    have hne : b - a ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hab)
    have h_sub : f b - f a = deriv f c * (b - a) := by
      rw [hc_eq, div_mul_cancel₀ (f b - f a) hne]
    have h_ba : |b - a| ≤ 1 := by rwa [abs_sub_comm] at hab_le
    have h_bound : |f a - f b| ≤ |deriv f c| * 1 := by
      calc
        |f a - f b| = |deriv f c| * |b - a| := by rw [abs_sub_comm (f a) (f b), h_sub, abs_mul]
        _ ≤ |deriv f c| * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_ba (abs_nonneg _)
    rw [mul_one] at h_bound
    exact h_bound.trans_lt hc_eps
  rcases lt_trichotomy x y with hlt | rfl | hgt
  · exact h_case x y hx hy hlt hxy
  · rw [sub_self, abs_zero]
    exact hε
  · rw [abs_sub_comm (f x) (f y)]
    have hxy' : |y - x| ≤ 1 := by rwa [abs_sub_comm] at hxy
    exact h_case y x hy hx hgt hxy'

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset Set
open scoped BigOperators

theorem Rudin_exercise_5_5_unit_oscillation
  {f : ℝ → ℝ}
  (hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioi 0))
  (hf : Tendsto (deriv f) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℝ, ∀ x y : ℝ, N ≤ x → N ≤ y → |x - y| ≤ 1 → |f x - f y| < ε := by
  intro ε hε
  rcases Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hf ε hε with ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩
  use max N₁ 1
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  have H : ∀ a b : ℝ, max N₁ 1 ≤ a → max N₁ 1 ≤ b → a ≤ b → |a - b| ≤ 1 → |f a - f b| < ε := by
    intro a b ha hb hab hdiff
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hab with rfl | hlt
    · rw [sub_self, abs_zero]
      exact hε
    · have ha_pos : 0 < a := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_trans (le_max_right N₁ 1) ha)
      have hsub : Icc a b ⊆ Ioi 0 := by
        intro t ht
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le ha_pos ht.1
      have hc : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b) := hfd.continuousOn.mono hsub
      have hd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioo a b) := hfd.mono (Ioo_subset_Icc_self.trans hsub)
      rcases exists_deriv_eq_slope f hlt hc hd with ⟨c, hc_ioo, hc_eq⟩
      have hc_ge : N₁ ≤ c := by
        have : N₁ ≤ a := le_trans (le_max_left N₁ 1) ha
        exact le_trans this (le_of_lt hc_ioo.1)
      have hc_dist := hN₁ c hc_ge
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at hc_dist
      have hba : b - a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hlt)
      have h_eq : f b - f a = deriv f c * (b - a) := by
        rw [hc_eq, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hba]
      have h_abs : |f a - f b| = |deriv f c| * (b - a) := by
        rw [abs_sub_comm (f a) (f b), h_eq, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hlt)]
      have hba_le : b - a ≤ 1 := by
        have := (abs_le.mp hdiff).1
        linarith
      have h_le : |deriv f c| * (b - a) ≤ |deriv f c| := by
        calc |deriv f c| * (b - a) ≤ |deriv f c| * 1 :=
               mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hba_le (abs_nonneg _)
             _ = |deriv f c| := mul_one _
      have h_final : |f a - f b| ≤ |deriv f c| := by
        rw [h_abs]
        exact h_le
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_final hc_dist
  rcases le_total x y with hle | hle
  · exact H x y hx hy hle hxy
  · rw [abs_sub_comm] at hxy ⊢
    exact H y x hy hx hle hxy
